step1_figure.circuit_type: 3-input NAND gate driving a load capacitance
step1_figure.description: The netlist defines a 3-input CMOS NAND gate with all three inputs tied together to a single 'Vin' node, driving a 50fF load capacitance. This matches the schematic in Figure 12.9 and the simulation setup described in Example 12.3 and Figure 12.10.

switching_point_voltage.description: The input voltage at which the input and output voltages are equal (Vin = Vout).

equation.formula: V_SP = (sqrt(beta_n / (N^2 * beta_p)) * V_THN + (VDD - V_THP)) / (1 + sqrt(beta_n / (N^2 * beta_p)))
equation.explanation: Calculates the switching threshold of an N-input NAND gate with all inputs tied together.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the actual W/L ratios chosen for the NMOS and PMOS devices. With equal sizes, it skews slightly above VDD/2 due to the series NMOS stack.

propagation_delay_low_to_high_full.description: The full calculation for low-to-high propagation delay including intrinsic parasitic capacitances.

equation.formula: t_PLH = 0.7 * (R_p / N) * (N * C_outp + C_outn / N + C_load)
equation.explanation: Calculates the low-to-high delay accounting for both the external load and the internal parasitic capacitances of the transistors.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming W/L=1, R_p approx 1 / (50e-6 * (1.8 - 0.42)) = 14.5 kOhm. Assuming parasitic caps C_outp, C_outn approx 1.5fF. t_PLH = 0.7 * (14.5k / 3) * (3*1.5f + 1.5f/3 + 50f) = 186 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Includes an estimate for parasitic capacitances which adds ~10% to the delay compared to the approximation.

propagation_delay_low_to_high_approx.description: The time it takes for the output to transition from low to high after the input transitions from high to low, approximated for large loads.

equation.explanation: Approximates the low-to-high delay when the load capacitance is much larger than the intrinsic parasitic capacitances.
equation.assumptions: C_load >> C_out, all inputs switch simultaneously.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using a simple linear resistance approximation for W/L=1. Actual delay will vary with device sizing.

propagation_delay_high_to_low_full.description: The full calculation for high-to-low propagation delay including intrinsic parasitic capacitances.

equation.formula: t_PHL = 0.7 * N * R_n * (N * C_outp + C_outn / N + C_load) + 0.35 * R_n * C_oxn * N^2
equation.explanation: Calculates the high-to-low delay accounting for both the external load and the internal parasitic capacitances of the series NMOS stack.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming W/L=1, R_n approx 1 / (270e-6 * (1.8 - 0.42)) = 2.68 kOhm. Assuming parasitic caps approx 1.5fF. t_PHL = 0.7 * 3 * 2.68k * (55f) + 0.35 * 2.68k * 1.5f * 9 = 309ps + 12ps = 321 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Includes estimates for parasitic capacitances and the intrinsic delay of the series stack.

propagation_delay_high_to_low_approx.description: The time it takes for the output to transition from high to low after the input transitions from low to high, approximated for large loads.

equation.explanation: Approximates the high-to-low delay when the load capacitance is much larger than the intrinsic parasitic capacitances.
equation.assumptions: C_load >> C_out, all inputs switch simultaneously.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using a simple linear resistance approximation for W/L=1. The series stack of 3 NMOS increases this delay significantly.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the switching point voltage (V_SP) using a DC sweep and the propagation delays (t_PHL, t_PLH) using a transient analysis with a pulsed input.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 3-input NAND testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Define parameters for W and L to resolve netlist variables
.param W_xm4=1 W_xm5=1 W_xm6=1 W_xm1=1 W_xm2=1 W_xm3=1
.param L_xm4=0.15 L_xm5=0.15 L_xm6=0.15 L_xm1=0.15 L_xm2=0.15 L_xm3=0.15

* DUT
VDD VDD 0 1.8
xm4 Vout Vin VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm1 P001 Vin 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 P002 Vin P001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm3 Vout Vin P002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm5 Vout Vin VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 Vout Vin VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
Cload Vout 0 5e-14

* Stimulus
Vin Vin 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 50p 50p 2n 4n)

* Dummy source to calculate Vout - Vin for exact V_SP measurement
B1 diff 0 V=v(Vout)-v(Vin)

.control
  * DC Analysis for V_SP
  dc Vin 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc vsp find v(Vin) when v(diff)=0
  print vsp

  * Transient Analysis for delays
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran t_phl trig v(Vin) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(Vout) val=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran t_plh trig v(Vin) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(Vout) val=0.9 rise=1
  print t_phl t_plh
  quit
.endc
.end
